newsitem.title: USA: Stocks fall on interest rate fears in year's lowest volume.
newsitem.headline: Stocks fall on interest rate fears in year's lowest volume.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks fell sharply in the slowest trading session of the year Friday after unexpectedly strong data reinforced fears that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates to head off inflation as the economy continues to grow.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended down 31.44 points at 5,616.21 after being down nearly 60 points early in the day. In the broader market, declining issues beat advances 2-1 on trading of 259 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
